// This implementation-time bridge is compiled into the production launchpad
// package using Go's source overlay. It calls the actual executor emitters and
// SDK/EVM store; it never constructs a log or reimplements event encoding.
package launchpad

import (
	"bytes"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"math/big"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"

	ibctransferkeeper "github.com/Sidiora-Labs/Paxeer-X-Network/interchain/modules/apps/transfer/keeper"
	evmkeeper "github.com/Sidiora-Labs/Paxeer-X-Network/modules/evm/keeper"
	"github.com/Sidiora-Labs/Paxeer-X-Network/modules/evm/state"
	launchpadkeeper "github.com/Sidiora-Labs/Paxeer-X-Network/modules/launchpad/keeper"
	pcommon "github.com/Sidiora-Labs/Paxeer-X-Network/precompiles/common"
	"github.com/Sidiora-Labs/Paxeer-X-Network/sdk/codec"
	codectypes "github.com/Sidiora-Labs/Paxeer-X-Network/sdk/codec/types"
	"github.com/Sidiora-Labs/Paxeer-X-Network/sdk/testutil"
	sdk "github.com/Sidiora-Labs/Paxeer-X-Network/sdk/types"
	authkeeper "github.com/Sidiora-Labs/Paxeer-X-Network/sdk/x/auth/keeper"
	authtypes "github.com/Sidiora-Labs/Paxeer-X-Network/sdk/x/auth/types"
	paramtypes "github.com/Sidiora-Labs/Paxeer-X-Network/sdk/x/params/types"
	"github.com/ethereum/go-ethereum/accounts/abi"
	"github.com/ethereum/go-ethereum/common"
	"github.com/ethereum/go-ethereum/core/types"
	"github.com/ethereum/go-ethereum/core/vm"
)

type recordM948Execution struct {
	Role     string
	Name     string
	CalledAt common.Address
	Log      *types.Log
	Args     map[string]any
}
type recordM948Refusal struct {
	Role, Name, Error     string
	LogsBefore, LogsAfter uint
}

func RecordM948Native(root, revision string, output io.Writer) error {
	key := sdk.NewKVStoreKey("record_m948_evm")
	transient := sdk.NewTransientStoreKey("record_m948_transient")
	ctx := testutil.DefaultContext(key, transient)
	cdc := codec.NewProtoCodec(codectypes.NewInterfaceRegistry())
	subspace := func(name string) paramtypes.Subspace {
		return paramtypes.NewSubspace(cdc, codec.NewLegacyAmino(), key, transient, name)
	}
	accounts := authkeeper.NewAccountKeeper(cdc, key, subspace("record_m948_auth"), authtypes.ProtoBaseAccount, map[string][]string{authtypes.FeeCollectorName: nil})
	keeper := evmkeeper.NewKeeper(key, transient, subspace("record_m948_evm"), nil, nil, &accounts, nil, ibctransferkeeper.Keeper{}, nil, nil, nil)
	db := state.NewDBImpl(ctx, keeper, false)
	defer db.Cleanup()
	evm := &vm.EVM{StateDB: db, Context: vm.BlockContext{Time: 73, BlockNumber: big.NewInt(41)}}
	p := PrecompileExecutor{abi: pcommon.MustGetABI(f, "abi.json")}
	transcript := struct {
		Revision     string
		SourceHashes map[string]string
		Family       []recordM948Execution
		Roles        []recordM948Execution
		Refusals     []recordM948Refusal
	}{Revision: revision, SourceHashes: map[string]string{}}
	for _, path := range []string{"precompiles/launchpad/events.go", "modules/launchpad/keeper/keeper.go"} {
		raw, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(root, path))
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		transcript.SourceHashes[path] = fmt.Sprintf("%x", sha256.Sum256(raw))
	}
	for _, name := range []string{"Swap", "PoolStateUpdated", "TokenDeployed", "MarketCreated", "NftMint", "FeeStrategyChanged", "NftTransfer", "PoolRegistered", "RouterTrade", "ConfigUpdated", "FeeFlow", "FeeDistributed"} {
		event := p.abi.Events[name]
		values, args, err := recordM948Values(event.Inputs[:len(event.Inputs)-2])
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		args["timestamp"] = "73"
		args["blockNumber"] = "41"
		before := len(db.GetAllLogs())
		if err = p.emitFamily(evm, name, values...); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		logs := db.GetAllLogs()
		if len(logs) != before+1 {
			return fmt.Errorf("%s emitted %d logs", name, len(logs)-before)
		}
		transcript.Family = append(transcript.Family, recordM948Execution{Name: name, CalledAt: common.HexToAddress(LaunchpadAddress), Log: logs[len(logs)-1], Args: args})
	}
	roleNames := []string{"FeeAccumulator", "PoolRegistry", "FeesRouter", "ProtocolConfig", "Quoter", "Router", "SidioraFactory", "SidioraNFT"}
	additional := map[string]string{"FeeAccumulator": "FeeRecorded", "PoolRegistry": "PoolRegistered", "FeesRouter": "FeesClaimed", "ProtocolConfig": "ConfigUpdated", "Router": "Buy", "SidioraFactory": "MarketCreated", "SidioraNFT": "Transfer"}
	for _, role := range roleNames {
		for _, name := range []string{"RoleGranted", "RoleRevoked", additional[role]} {
			if name == "" {
				continue
			}
			event := roleABIs[role].Events[name]
			values, args, err := recordM948Values(event.Inputs)
			if err != nil {
				return err
			}
			origins := []common.Address{launchpadkeeper.Generation2Surfaces[role]}
			if (role == "Router" || role == "FeesRouter") && name != "RoleGranted" && name != "RoleRevoked" {
				origins = append(origins, common.HexToAddress(LaunchpadAddress))
			}
			for _, at := range origins {
				before := len(db.GetAllLogs())
				if err = p.emitAt(evm, role, at, name, values...); err != nil {
					return err
				}
				logs := db.GetAllLogs()
				if len(logs) != before+1 {
					return fmt.Errorf("%s.%s emitted %d logs", role, name, len(logs)-before)
				}
				transcript.Roles = append(transcript.Roles, recordM948Execution{role, name, at, logs[len(logs)-1], args})
			}
		}
		before := uint(len(db.GetAllLogs()))
		err := p.emitAt(evm, role, launchpadkeeper.Generation2Surfaces[role], "Initialized", uint64(1))
		if err == nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("%s Initialized accepted", role)
		}
		transcript.Refusals = append(transcript.Refusals, recordM948Refusal{role, "Initialized", err.Error(), before, uint(len(db.GetAllLogs()))})
	}
	encoder := json.NewEncoder(output)
	encoder.SetIndent("", "  ")
	return encoder.Encode(transcript)
}
func recordM948Values(inputs abi.Arguments) ([]any, map[string]any, error) {
	values := []any{}
	expected := map[string]any{}
	for i, arg := range inputs {
		n := byte(i + 1)
		var value, human any
		switch arg.Type.String() {
		case "address":
			address := common.BytesToAddress(bytes.Repeat([]byte{n}, 20))
			value = address
			human = strings.ToLower(address.Hex())
		case "bytes32":
			var hash [32]byte
			copy(hash[:], bytes.Repeat([]byte{n}, 32))
			value = hash
			human = "0x" + hex.EncodeToString(hash[:])
		case "uint256":
			integer := new(big.Int).Add(new(big.Int).Lsh(big.NewInt(1), 192), big.NewInt(int64(n)))
			value = integer
			human = integer.String()
		case "uint8":
			value = n
			human = n
		case "uint64":
			value = uint64(n)
			human = uint64(n)
		case "bool":
			value = true
			human = true
		case "string":
			value = arg.Name + " λ / native executor"
			human = value
		default:
			return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("unsupported producer argument %s", arg.Type.String())
		}
		values = append(values, value)
		expected[arg.Name] = human
	}
	return values, expected, nil
}
